title: Siemens Healthineers
description: cancercare.siemens-healthineers.com Siemens Healthineers Cancer Care is the oncology division of Siemens Healthineers built on its 2021 acquisition of Varian Medical Systems for 16.4 billion dollars, the global leader in radiation therapy. Led by Head of Varian Arthur Kaindl and CMO Dr Dee Khuntia, it unites imaging, radiotherapy, software and interventional oncology under one ecosystem serving 70 locations with 11,000 employees. Its mission is a world without fear of cancer, spanning the entire patient journey from screening and diagnosis through treatment planning, delivery and survivorship. The portfolio includes flagship linacs TrueBeam, Halcyon, Edge and Ethos, plus the ARIA oncology platform, Eclipse treatment planning, Noona patient engagement and HyperSight imaging. In September 2026 it launched Accela, a breakthrough system built on NeoArc dynamic modulated arc therapy enabling multi site SBRT in 60 seconds and single breath hold treatments, developed with Mayo Clinic, MSK.
